d:
Yupi men guruvar ko ol indiya majlis-e-ittehadul muslimin (eaaeeemaaaeeem) aur aazad samaj parti (kanshiram) ki jvoint raili huee. bite 12 navanbar ko donon hi partiyon ke netaon ne sajha gathbandhan ki ghoshna ki thi. is gathbandhan ko samajik parivartan morcha nam diya gaya tha.
Is raili men shamil hue log kya bole? varishth patrakar asad rizvi is raili ko kitna saphal mante hain? dekhie bibisi sanvaddata prerna aur tariq khan ki ye riport.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
